prompt: Compose a COMPLETE original 30-second instrumental micro-score for a short product promotional video. Exactly one short cue, not a full-length song. Sound: bright compact house; buoyant chord stabs with a memorable bass hook. Instruments: rounded kick, electric piano stabs, bright synth bass, shakers. Tempo 124 BPM, 4/4. Main hook: a falling three-note figure. [00:00] Immediate confident musical hook and beat within the first half-second, no intro or fade-in. [00:02] Establish a catchy clear groove with space for visual edits. [00:16] One crisp stop-and-restart or timbral switch, then a slightly fuller reprise. [00:26] A concise resolving fill. [00:29] A decisive final musical button for a logo reveal. [00:30] End completely after the brief natural decay. Total duration 30 seconds. Maintain the hook throughout, usable from any downbeat. Punchy but not harsh, audible melody and rhythm on phone speakers, controlled sub-bass, no long riser, no slow build or repeated sections. Instrumental only. No vocals, choir, humming, singing, speech, lyrics or vocal samples. Do not imitate any artist, existing song or brand jingle.

description.en: An energetic electronic track featuring driving synth melodies, a prominent dance beat, and dynamic synth basslines. The music evolves from an upbeat electronic style to a more house-influenced sound, maintaining a consistent high energy throughout.
